# Digital Humani

Digital Humani provides a reforestation API for browsing planting projects, submitting tree-planting requests, and tracking planted trees.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/digital-humani/.

## Actions

- **Get Current User and Enterprise** (read-only): Return the authenticated Digital Humani user and that user's enterprise details, including the enterprise ID needed by planting and…
- **Get Enterprise Tree Count** (read-only): Count trees for an enterprise across all time, one calendar month, or an inclusive date range.
- **Get Reforestation Project** (read-only): Return detailed information for one reforestation project, including whether it is active and its localized project fields.
- **Get Tree Request** (read-only): Retrieve a tree-planting request by the UUID returned when it was created.
- **Get User Tree Count** (read-only): Count trees attributed to an exact end-user identifier within an enterprise.
- **List Reforestation Projects** (read-only): List reforestation project summaries and IDs.
- **Plant Trees**: CHARGEABLE PRODUCTION PURCHASE.
